# airflow_fab_role (Data Source)

Fetches an Airflow FAB role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "airflow_fab_role" "viewer" {
  name       = "Viewer"
}

output "viewer_role" {
  value = data.airflow_fab_role.viewer
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes Set) A list of permissions (action/resource pairs) assigned to the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The name of the action (e.g., can_read, can_edit).
- `resource` (String) The name of the resource (e.g., DAGs, Dashboard).
